note: Daily scan 22 Nov: two more Hormuz tanker strikes; no UAE attacks or utility news. Houthi missiles at Riyadh left out as outside scope.

signals.source: Gulf News / Khaleej Times / TradeArabia: UAE business and utilities
signals.summary: UKMTO reported two tanker strikes near Khasab on 21 Nov: one hit on the stern about 11 nm north, and one hit in the engine room 17 nm east; no casualties. Iran's navy claimed another tanker hit a mine east of the strait, and Iranian TV showed a new underground missile launcher. US-Iran contacts continue through intermediaries with no deal.
signals.check: Strikes are now daily, and a new launcher points to sustained capacity. No new action beyond SQ-0104; keep tracking supplier delivery dates through Hormuz.
signals.notes: Opened Gulf News evening briefing (21 Nov, grade C) and The New Arab (21 Nov) citing UKMTO. Follows SQ-0104. Context for ER-01.
